content.comment_body: Hello, what is the highest number of timers or counters that can be used in [product_name]? Regards [user_name]

For [product_name] with [article_no] - 200 function blocks are supported. For [product_name] with [article_no] - 400 function blocks are supported. These function blocks can be timers, counters, logic functions, or other types. Hope this clarifies.
The total number also depends on the memory available in the device.
You can use CTRL + H to select hardware, which lets you view all blocks and available options for your [product_name] module.

Hello, check the handbook as only some block types have a specific usage limit, such as: - Hours counter - Message texts - Shift register - Analog filter ([version_no] only). Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in determining the maximum functional block capacity for timers and counters in [product_name] hardware. Limits vary by hardware version, built-in memory, and certain block type-specific rules.
